message.content:
Heavy wool overcoat in a charcoal grey shade (#36454F), tailored straight cut, knee-length hem, dense felt fabric.
Chunky knit turtleneck sweater in an oatmeal color (#E3D8C1), relaxed fit, crew neck, soft merino blend.
Dark wash denim jeans in a medium blue tone (#2C3A47), standard straight leg, mid-thigh length, durable cotton twill.
Insulated waterproof ankle boots in black with a rubber sole and thick tread, shaft height at mid-calf, oil-tanned leather exterior.

This ensemble is perfectly suited for walking briskly through ten degrees of frost and snow to the office. The wool coat provides essential warmth against the cold wind while remaining breathable enough for twenty minutes of exposure without overheating upon arrival. The waterproof boots ensure her feet stay dry on salted roads, preventing slippage during the walk. Inside, the layered textures of the knit sweater and denim offer comfort and style that respects her request for a neat yet everyday work look without violating her refusals against formal attire.
